text: so, why doesnt this one show up? [Image #19] in the compiled game
resolution: NET CAFE now compiles (commit 10e82086b). WHY it didn't: it's not a decal — it's one of the hand-coded React facade textures (buildingSkins REACT_TEXTURES), which are code, not data: no WGSL recipe and no DecalDoc, so the bake had nothing to ship and the face fell to flat color (the documented retiring-catalog GAP). THE FIX: a built-in DecalDoc transcription table (game/textures/builtinDecals.ts) — internetCafe is transcribed faithfully (monitor grid colors computed from the facade's own cellHash: teal/dark/purple over dark/dark/pink, plus the neon-bordered NET CAFE sign band) and the bake resolves built-ins right after custom decals, through the exact same recipe pipe the /compose decals use. Bake now reports 3 decal recipe(s); shot GREEN; tests 6/6. Verify: rjit game play and look at the NET CAFE walls. Note: other react facades (office/retail/gunShop/mall...) still ship flat until transcribed — each is one more entry in the same table, or re-author them in /compose; the catalog itself is still slated to retire with V24.
